declarations.name: AuiKanban

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the board (role=group); the toolbar is named '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Columns in display order: { id (unique), label, wipLimit? (1..10000 cards across swimlanes), collapsed? (initial), locked? (no cards move into or out of it) }. At least one. Replacing it clears the undo history.

inputs.name: lanes
inputs.description: Swimlanes (rows): { id, label, collapsed? }. With lanes every card needs a laneId.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Cards (and columns) can be moved. false hides the toolbar, grips, and column handles; arrow-key navigation and Enter still work.

inputs.name: columnReorder
inputs.description: Show column handles for reordering columns (when editable).

inputs.name: renderCard
inputs.description: Card content ({ column, lane, doc }). Return non-interactive content: the card is the focusable list item and its text is read by screen readers. Default: title, description, tags.

inputs.name: canMove
inputs.description: Veto a move (keyboard moves skip refused columns; pointer drops show an invalid target). Locked cards and columns, and full columns under wipPolicy 'block', are always refused.

inputs.name: moveCard
inputs.description: Save a move after it was applied. While it runs the card is aria-busy and cannot move again. A rejection or a timeout (requestTimeoutMs) moves the card back, removes the move from the history, announces the failure, and emits aui-move-error.

inputs.name: wipPolicy
inputs.description: 'warn' marks columns over their limit ('Over limit' text and icon); 'block' also refuses moves into a column at its limit (moves within the column stay possible).

inputs.name: virtualThreshold
inputs.description: Cells with more cards than this (20..100000) scroll on their own and render only the cards in view (measured heights, spacers, aria-setsize/aria-posinset).

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: aria-level of column and swimlane headings (2..6).

models.name: cards
models.description: Cards: { id (unique), columnId, laneId? (required with lanes), title, description?, tags? (chips), color? (1..8 accent stripe), locked? }. The order within a cell is the array order. Validated (KANBAN_OPTIONS). Replacing it clears the undo history and aborts pending saves.

outputs.name: cardActivated
outputs.description: Enter on a card, or a click (outside a single-pointer move).

outputs.name: cardMoved
outputs.description: Before a move is applied; preventDefault() keeps the card where it was.

outputs.name: moveError
outputs.description: moveCard rejected or timed out; the card is back where it was.

outputs.name: columnMoved
outputs.description: Before a column reorder is applied; preventDefault() keeps the order.

outputs.name: collapseChange
outputs.description: A column or swimlane was collapsed or expanded.

properties.name: canUndo
properties.description: Read-only: A move or column reorder can be undone.

properties.name: canRedo
properties.description: Read-only: An undone change can be redone.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: Read-only: Ids of cards whose move is being saved.

methods.name: positionOf
methods.description: Column, swimlane (null without swimlanes), and index of a card.

methods.name: moveColumn
methods.signature: moveColumn(id: string, index: number): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Move a column in the column order (undoable, emits aui-column-move).

methods.name: setCollapsed
methods.signature: setCollapsed(kind: "column" | "lane", id: string, collapsed: boolean): void
methods.description: Collapse or expand a column or swimlane (emits aui-collapse-change).

methods.name: focusCard
methods.description: Focus a card, expanding its column and swimlane and scrolling a virtual cell to it.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last move or column reorder (saved through moveCard with reason 'undo'). Refused while saves are pending.

accessibility.pattern: Headed lists: a named group (the board) containing column headings and, with swimlanes, labelled sections; each cell is a named list (role=list) of focusable list items (cards) with aria-posinset and aria-setsize. One roving tab stop covers all cards; arrow keys move between cards and columns. Moves follow the Sortable List grab-and-move model (Space picks up, arrows move, Space drops, Escape cancels) with live-region announcements, plus a single-pointer path through the toolbar (WCAG 2.5.7). No deprecated ARIA drag-and-drop attributes.

limitations: Only cards within a cell are virtualized (above virtualThreshold); columns and swimlanes are always rendered.
WIP limits apply per column across all swimlanes (no per-swimlane limits).
A card with a pending save cannot be moved again, and undo waits until all saves finish.
A failed save moves the card back and drops that move from the undo history.
Pointer drags are not announced step by step (keyboard moves are).
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
